propositions: _lifecycle_index uses dict.setdefault when mapping canonical schema keys to lifecycle notes, causing silent loss of the second and subsequent notes if multiple deprecation aliases or tombstones target the same canonical replacement key
no live collision exists in the current registry (each replacement key is targeted exactly once across REGISTRY and tombstones), but the latent gap poses risk if a future deprecation adds a collision

_lifecycle_index must accumulate all notes per canonical key into a list and join them into a single Lifecycle cell, rendering byte-identically for single-note cases so committed docs require no regeneration

new unit tests must seed collisions by monkeypatching _cfg_deprecations and _cfg_tombstones to verify both alias/tombstone notes survive in the rendered row, and must be RED against unmodified main before the fix lands
